segments.caption: A shirtless boy walks toward a large blue and yellow inflatable water slide and pool set up on a grassy lawn, joining other children already playing and splashing in the water at the base of the slide.
Children play and slide down a large, colorful inflatable water slide in a backyard, splashing in the pool at the bottom as others climb up the sides.
Children joyfully slide down a large, colorful inflatable water slide into a splash pool, with others waiting at the top or playing in the water below.
Children joyfully climb and slide down a large, colorful inflatable water slide, splashing into the pool at the bottom as others wait their turn on the grassy lawn.

Children are actively climbing and sliding down a large, colorful inflatable water slide at an outdoor event, with a constant flow of kids moving up the lanes and splashing into the water at the bottom.
Children of various ages are actively playing on a large, multi-lane inflatable water slide, climbing up the sides and sliding down in a continuous, lively flow.
Children slide down a colorful inflatable water slide into a large inflatable pool, with the camera panning to show the surrounding green, tree-lined yard.

A young boy in blue swim trunks walks across a grassy yard toward the camera, revealing a temporary sloth tattoo on his chest, while a large blue and yellow inflatable structure sits nearby in the sunny outdoor setting.
